payload.friendly_name: Consolidation claim, rollback and teardown integrity
payload.purpose_context: Operators running spec-kitty consolidate can today end up with a refused consolidation that already merged lanes, recorded work as done, numbered the mission or even advanced the target branch, while the message says nothing was mutated. The next attempt then refuses the mission's own work. This mission makes consolidation refuse before it changes anything when it already knows it must refuse, restore every branch it moved when a later check fails, stop a planning work package from writing code-lane content straight onto the target, and report truthfully what moved.
payload.purpose_tldr: A refused or failed spec-kitty consolidate never leaves half-mutated branches or state behind, and never claims nothing changed when something did.

payload.question: Which issues does slice 10 cover by 2026-09-30?

payload.final_answer: 3 P0s + fold #5332 (#5338 first, then #5318, #5296; #5332 as another rollback caller; residuals R1/R2 not folded)

payload.question: How does a failed gate restore the mission/coordination branch?

payload.final_answer: CAS ref restore: one persisted pre-mutation snapshot + one CAS rollback authority restoring every captured ref; supersedes AC-B3 revert-only on this path; amend ADR 2026-09-19-1

payload.question: How is the planning-lane dependency self-heal (#5296) fixed?

payload.final_answer: Refuse (fail closed) when a planning WP dependency self-heal would merge code lanes into the repository-root checkout on the target branch; guidance: consolidate code lanes first; refusal text derived from what actually moved

payload.question: Refusing the planning claim deadlocks (consolidate requires all WPs approved; no per-lane consolidate). What should a planning-lane claim do when its self-heal would merge code lanes onto the target checkout?

payload.final_answer: Skip merge, waive ancestry: when the planning lane worktree is the repository root checkout on the target branch, the dependency self-heal does not merge code lanes and the claim-ancestry gate waives code-lane ancestry; claim proceeds, target untouched; code arrives via consolidation's attribution window. Supersedes DM 01M3PD41NQ6J6EX8V2HYDDRGPZ.
